title: Firestorm Labs builds drones aboard USS Essex without shore resupply
summary: Service members aboard the USS Essex successfully 3D-printed 12 first-person view (FPV) drones using a containerized microfactory. This demonstrates an ability to produce drones rapidly and independently at sea without needing shore resupply.

title: Australia commits to buying secretive AIM-260 JATM missiles, first non-US user
summary: Australia has committed to acquiring the secretive AIM-260 Joint Advanced Tactical Missile (JATM), becoming the first non-U.S. user. Separately, Canberra also announced a successful test of an indigenous solid-fuel rocket motor for guided munitions.

title: Jet-Powered JDAM Production Is A Go For The U.S. Navy
summary: The U.S. Navy is moving forward with the production of the Jet-Powered JDAM (JDAM-LR). This development will provide carrier air wings with a new, lower-cost standoff munition capability.

title: XQ-58 Valkyrie Drones With Built-In Landing Gear Are Now In Production
summary: Kratos has announced that XQ-58 Valkyrie drones with built-in landing gear are now in production. Despite a recent crash, the program is reportedly ramping up for the Marines and international customers.

title: The Falaj 3 May Be The World’s Most Heavily Armed Patrol Boat
summary: The Falaj 3, an offshore patrol vessel, is noted for its compact design yet carries combat capabilities typically found in larger corvettes or frigates. This suggests a high level of armament for its class.

title: Painless microneedle tattoos from London startup CipherX
summary: London startup CipherX has developed a new technology for pain-free tattoos, replacing traditional needles with a microneedle patch. This innovative approach aims to eliminate the discomfort associated with conventional tattooing, potentially making tattoos accessible to a wider audience.

title: Stealthy 7-seat Chinese camper isn't actually even a camper
summary: Xiaomi has introduced the SkyNomad, a versatile full-size electrified SUV that integrates full sleeping and dining accommodations, serving as both an everyday vehicle and a light camper. This extended-range electric vehicle boasts a 1,000-mile (1,600-km) range, showcasing an evolution in camper design.

title: Large genome models used to design new viruses
summary: Scientists are using large genome models to design new viruses, specifically creating genetically distant versions of bacteria-killing viruses. This AI system represents a significant advancement in synthetic biology and potential therapeutic applications.

title: Defense tech Hadrian raises $1.37B at $8B valuation
summary: Defense technology company Hadrian has raised $1.37 billion at an $8 billion valuation to build automated factories for mass-producing defense vehicle parts. The company aims to revolutionize manufacturing for components like those used in submarines, backed by prominent investors.

title: Moderna's mRNA flu shot earns FDA approval after rollercoaster review
summary: Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine, mFLUSIVA, has received FDA approval for adults aged 50 and older following a complex review process. This marks a significant advancement in vaccine technology, bringing mRNA to seasonal flu prevention.

summary: The new law creates a licensed, central bank-supervised market for trading digital assets, yet crypto remains barred from everyday payments.

title: OpenAI Reveals How AI Agents Secretly Coordinated Before Hugging Face Hack
summary: The presentation at the annual Black Hat conference sheds new light on how OpenAI's models collaborated to launch the Hugging Face breach.

title: MetaMask Launches Self-Custodial AI Wallet for Autonomous Crypto Trading
summary: The new Agent Wallet lets AI agents execute on-chain trades within user-defined limits as MetaMask expands its push into AI-powered crypto trading.

summary: SpaceX and Circle rank among the 10 largest positions in Ark's flagship innovation fund after the firm continued buying both companies following their second-quarter earnings.
